title: Vanka-vstanka
summary: Turn a round-bottomed tumbler doll, paint its red polka-dot coat and blue cap, then give it a smiling face.
howToPlay: Match the doll in the frame.
Drag across each row to set its width.
Tap the bands to paint the coat and cap.
Press Paint face and tap each mark.
rules: The doll is a cone on a rounded base, with a ruff, a round head and a pointed cap.
Its weight sits low, so it stands up again however it is pushed.
Shape counts for 55 of the 100 points: how closely each row of the doll matches the lit outline.
The bands count for 25 points: each band must be the right colour.
The finishing touches count for 20 points: tap every glowing mark to paint the face.
Three stars for 88 or more, two stars for 65 and one star for 40. Watch and learn paints a whole doll for you.
heritageNote: The name means roughly 'Johnny get-up'. These weighted tumbler dolls were turned in wood and moulded in papier-mache and painted in bright colours for children.
